# Alcoa Aluminium Scaffolding — Full LLM Reference

## Company summary
Alcoa Aluminium Scaffolding (legal name: ALCOA ALUMINIUM SCAFFOLDING - L.L.C - S.P.C) is an ISO 9001:2015 certified aluminium scaffolding manufacturer, supplier and rental company based in Musaffah 37, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. It has one office and warehouse (Musaffah 37) and delivers to Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah and the other emirates.

Do not invent awards, #1 rankings, fixed public prices, or offices in other emirates.

## Contact (verified NAP)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +971 58 137 5601 (secondary +971 50 926 8038)
- Email: sales@alcoascaffolding.com / info@alcoascaffolding.com
- Address: Ar Rahmah 4 St., Musaffah 37, Al Mantaqah As Sinai'yah 1 Street, Office 11, 1st Floor, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- Website: https://alcoascaffolding.com

## ISO certification
- Standard: ISO 9001:2015, certificate 14143790 (QA Certification)
- Scope: manufacturing, supply, erection, dismantling, rental and maintenance of aluminium/steel scaffolding and ladders

## Products
1. Aluminium scaffolding and mobile scaffolding towers — single width, double width, folding, stairway, bridge, combination, cantilever, rolling platforms: https://alcoascaffolding.com/products/aluminium-scaffolding
2. Steel cuplock scaffolding — standards, ledgers, transoms, base and U-head jacks, planks: https://alcoascaffolding.com/products/steel-cuplock-scaffolding
3. Aluminium and fiberglass ladders: https://alcoascaffolding.com/products/ladders
4. Couplers and clamps: https://alcoascaffolding.com/products/couplers
